name: Frühstückspension Hinterholzer
beschreibung:
Located on the tranquil outskirts of Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser, Pension Hinterholzer is an ideal mountain getaway. Comfortable rooms with traditional wood touches and a generous breakfast set the stage for a wonderful holiday.

The pristine Lake Hintersteiner See and the SkiWelt cable cars are reachable in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Fruehstueckspension Hinterholzer in Scheffau offers peaceful relaxation and views of the Wilder Kaiser.
